description: Search your team's folders (by name or description), assets (by title) and feedback (by text) at once; always returns all three categories. Asset hits have the contents shape: asset_id (the asset), version_id (its current version), version_count, the current version's media fields, url (current version) and version_url. Feedback hits carry asset_id = the version the comment was left on, and url.
name: search
title: Search folders, assets and feedback
